sourceRefs.locator: The Byzantine Harbours of Constantinople, pp. 19–24, figs. 2 and 4. Paper watermarks and pictorial evidence for the Düsseldorf copy’s date, Pera and Constantinople on fol. 54r, Valens aqueduct, Kontoskalion/Kadırgalimanı with basins, gate, five shipsheds and a galley.

Düsseldorf, MS G 13, fol. 54r. Full 2,184 × 3,181 PNG and its file-history and licensing sections (faithful reproduction, Public Domain Mark). Dating and attribution to this copy are checked against Effenberger, fig. 2.

labels.de: Pera und Konstantinopel auf einem Blatt
labels.en: Pera and Constantinople on a single sheet

note.de: Die Düsseldorfer Handschrift des Inselbuchs von Buondelmonti zeigt beide Ufer und die Schiffsschuppen am Marmarameer. Der Kartenpunkt bezeichnet die dargestellte Stadt.
note.en: The Düsseldorf copy of Buondelmonti’s book of islands shows both shores and the shipsheds on the Sea of Marmara. The point marks the city depicted.
